stem: Most vehicle fuels contain hydrocarbons obtained from crude oil.

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: State the name of the type of reaction that hydrocarbons undergo when being used as fuels.

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Write an equation for the reaction of octane, $\text{C}_8\text{H}_{18}$, as a fuel, as in **(a)(i)**.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.stem: The supply of material suitable for use as fuels directly from crude oil is **not** sufficient to meet demand. A process is carried out to make some of the larger hydrocarbon molecules more useful.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.stem: As well as producing fuels, this process produces compounds suitable for use in the production of polymers. An example of such a compound is but-2-ene, $\text{CH}_3\text{CH=CHCH}_3$.
parts.text: Draw the repeat unit of the polymer that is produced from but-2-ene.

parts.label: (b)(iii)
parts.text: Name the type of polymerisation that occurs during the production of the polymer in **(ii)**.

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.stem:
Gases produced in internal combustion engines include carbon monoxide, oxides of nitrogen such as $\text{NO}_2$, and unburnt hydrocarbons.

These gases are removed from the exhaust before they can enter the atmosphere.
parts.text: State what is used to remove these gases from the exhaust.

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text: Write **one** equation to show how both carbon monoxide, $\text{CO}$, and nitrogen dioxide, $\text{NO}_2$, are removed from the exhaust.

parts.label: (c)(iii)
parts.text: State the environmental consequence of allowing unburnt hydrocarbons to enter the atmosphere.

parts.label: (d)(i)
parts.stem: Vehicle fuels are treated to remove sulfur. If sulfur is present in a fuel when it is burned, $\text{SO}_2$ is produced and may be released into the atmosphere where it can form acid rain.
parts.text:
Acid rain can contribute to breathing difficulties.

Identify **two** other consequences of acid rain in the atmosphere.

parts.label: (d)(ii)
parts.text:
$\text{NO}_2$ is involved in the production of acid rain from $\text{SO}_2$.

Give **two** equations which describe how acid rain is formed by the action of $\text{NO}_2$ with $\text{SO}_2$.

parts.label: (d)(iii)
parts.text:
$\text{NO}_2$ is described as a catalyst during this process.

Explain, with the use of an appropriate equation, why $\text{NO}_2$ is described as a catalyst.
